items.evidence: session-log.txt:2578-2612 — navigate-in-constructor code, crash 0xC000027B, then fixed to the exact Activated-deferred pattern documented at MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md lines 219-231.
items.covered_clearly_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md lines 193-231 (#windowing 'Initialization order — keep MainWindow's constructor inert'), including the verbatim Activated-deferred RootFrame.Navigate example.
items.why_no_skill_change: PARTIAL — the pitfall IS documented prominently in the patterns file and the agent recovered in ~3 turns, so the reactive guidance is adequate. However, because the shell-building step (SKILL.md Shell Conversion) gives no forward pointer to it, this is tracked as a coverage-gap (item 2) rather than left purely as a slip; the skill edit adds the missing forward reference rather than restating the pattern.
